title: Projects & Mastery Practice 2
statement:
Module 6 (Projects & Mastery) covers: nosql vs sql, data warehousing basics, database capstone, migrations and schema evolution, specialized databases, query review checklist. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Data Warehousing Basics).
hints: Re-read the Data Warehousing Basics lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
